summary: Bank of the James Financial Group files 8-K reporting Q1 2026 earnings and a board-declared quarterly cash dividend of $0.10 per share, payable June 5, 2026 to holders of record May 22, 2026. No acquisition, divestiture, tender, or restructuring is involved. The press release highlights net income of $2.77M ($0.61 EPS) versus $0.19 a year ago, higher net interest income, and lower expenses. The dividend is a regular capital return event, not a special one-off. The filing is purely operational and routine capital allocation.
